BABZ00 is a medical classification code used to denote the insertion of an epidural catheter (*Anlæggelse af epiduralkateter*) [^src1]. Within the context of the Danish healthcare system's quality development initiatives for acute surgery, this code plays a specific role in tracking and measuring [[epidural-use|epidural use]] during patient treatment [^src1]. Specifically, BABZ00, along with the code NAAD0* (*Epidural blokade*), indicates whether an epidural was utilized in a patient's treatment regimen [^src1].

The application of the BABZ00 code represents a strategic methodological adjustment in how data is sourced for national quality indicators. It is now collected directly from the Danish National Patient Register (LPR) to calculate Indicator 9, a change implemented to optimize and improve the underlying data basis for quality assessments [^src1]. This technical adjustment is part of a broader effort by the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute and the LKT Acute Surgery group to refine standardized indicators, risk adjustments, and continuous database operations to improve treatment standards in acute surgical care [^src1].
